newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Village Roadshow plans to buy resort.
newsitem.headline: Village Roadshow plans to buy resort.

text.p: Cinema and theme park operator Village Roadshow Ltd said on Monday that it had entered into a conditional contract to buy the Laguna Quays resort in Queensland for an undisclosed sum.
The company said the acquisition was below materiality thresholds required for continuous disclosure and further information would be released when all conditions had been fulfilled late next week.
The resort, located on the coast of Queensland near the Whitsunday Islands, was placed in receivership by the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd in May 1995.
Its Japanese-backed developer, Aqua Del Ray, had spent A$250 million on the resort's development.
Newspaper reports said last month that the resort might be sold to Village Roadshow for as little as A$20 million.
The company said in Monday's statement that a meeting of creditors of Laguna Quays Resort Pty Ltd and Aqua Del Rey International Pty Ltd would be held on August 14.
Village is also the owner of the Daydream Island resort on Queensland's Barrier Reef, acquired for A$22.5 million in January 1996 from the receivers of developer Jennings Group Ltd.
